content.text: Now I'll validate the redlines for the deviations and missing clauses.

input.summary: Insert mutual liability cap with standard uncapped carve-outs
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no limitation of liability at all, leaving both parties exposed to unlimited and consequential damages. We have added a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap.

ops.text: Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (i) the amounts paid or payable by the Company to HDI under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (ii) USD 1,000,000, and neither Party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's obligation to pay amounts due under Section 3 shall not be treated as damages for purposes of this cap.

input.summary: Insert HDI indemnity covering IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and misconduct
input.comment: [Playbook] HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site and handles customer order data, but gives no indemnity. We have added a standard HDI defence and indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, unauthorised disclosure of Company data and wilful misconduct.

ops.text: Indemnification. HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Site or any materials or technology provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) HDI's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorised access to or disclosure of Content, user information or customer data caused by HDI; or (iv) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The Company shall give HDI prompt notice of the claim, and HDI shall control the defence and settlement with the Company's reasonable cooperation, provided that no settlement imposing any obligation on the Company shall be made without the Company's consent.

input.summary: Narrow the restraint on the Company to the named Deerskin-branded site, with carve-outs
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a restriction on the businesses we operate or the products we sell, and "products substantially similar to Deerskin Products ... and companies similar to" is open-ended. We have narrowed the covenant to a competing Deerskin-branded consumer web site during the term, with carve-outs for internal development and acquired businesses.

ops.oldText: the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)
ops.newText: the Company shall not operate a self-contained web site offering Deerskin Products directly to consumers on the Internet (provided that this restriction shall not apply to the Company's internal development activities, to any business or product line acquired by the Company, or to any other products, brands or channels)

input.summary: Shorten the Company's non-renewal notice window to 30 days, keep HDI at 90 days
input.comment: [Playbook] A 90-day non-renewal window is longer than we accept on an annually auto-renewing term; we have moved the Company to 30 days while leaving HDI at 90 days so it cannot exit on short notice.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
ops.newText: unless terminated by the Company upon thirty (30) days written notice to HDI, or by HDI upon ninety (90) days written notice to the Company
